text: This is AvaVault Perp, a real, running on-chain finance project on the Avalanche testnet, built for the On-chain Finance and Trading track. Real-world-asset tokens usually just sit idle earning yield, with poor liquidity. Meanwhile, perpetual traders need stablecoin margin, and cashing out a yield position means losing its upside.

Our insight: if an RWA token has even a thin liquidity pool on a DEX, it has a price any contract can read in real time. We fused three bootcamp lessons into one product: DEX price oracles, RWA yield tokens, and an off-chain-matching, on-chain-settled perpetual vault. Deposit your rental-income token, and trade perpetuals directly.

None of this is staged. Every contract is really deployed on Avalanche Fuji testnet and verifiable on Snowtrace. Here, a user deposits one hundred real-estate rental-rights tokens as margin. And here, two counterparties settle a trade using an EIP-712 signed authorization, with every balance change on-chain and checkable.

This live dashboard shows nothing hardcoded. Every refresh re-reads real Fuji chain state: total token supply, collateral held in the vault, and margin value computed live from DEX reserves. Below, our perpetual exchange engine in action, with real order book depth, real matching, and real on-chain settlement end to end.

We chose Avalanche for its sub-second finality and extremely low gas, which is what makes frequent on-chain price reads and margin settlement actually practical. Our real transactions cost a fraction of a cent in AVAX. AvaVault Perp puts sleeping real-world assets back to work. Thanks for watching, we're building the next wave of on-chain finance on Avalanche.
